Homura Ham ® is a registered trademark. All rights to our videos, photos, and logos are protected by copyright.

This channel is about the fun and adventurous life of our cute hamsters. 
Watch them run through cardboard mazes, obstacle courses, and enjoy many more creative setups!

If you liked this video, give it a thumbs up 👍 and subscribe to our channel :)
